gizmo.title: Kuongorora zvakaverengwa
gizmo.description: Vadzidzi vanoisa mireza pamitsara, ndima kana mifananidzo iri muzvinyorwa zvinova humbowo hwechiratidzo chimwe nechimwe, kana kusarudza chikamu chinopindura mubvunzo zvakanyanya.

configure.title: Basa
configure.description: Isa mureza pahumbowo: vadzidzi vanoisa mureza wega wega padivi pehumbowo hwawo. Sarudza chimwe: vadzidzi vanosarudza chikamu chimwe chete chinopindura mubvunzo zvakanyanya.

configure.title: Vadzidzi vanosarudza
configure.description: Zvinonongedzwa nemudzidzi muzvinyorwa. Mifananidzo inogona kusarudzwa nguva dzose.

configure.title: Mireza
configure.description: Zviratidzo zvinoiswa nevadzidzi. Shandisa Maka mhinduro mumenyu yebhuroka kusarudza panofanira kuiswa chimwe nechimwe.

configure.title: Zvinyorwa
configure.description: Zvinyorwa zvinoshandirwa nevadzidzi. Chero HTML: misoro, ndima, zvinyorwa zvakarongwa nemifananidzo.

advanced.title: Kuedza
advanced.description: Kakawanda kunogona mudzidzi kutarisa. 0 zvinoreva kusingagumi.

advanced.title: Inopeteka
advanced.description: Sarudza mubvunzo uyu semutsetse unozaruka nekuvharika. Kuvhura mumwe kunovharisa mimwe mibvunzo inopeteka iri padhuze.

advanced.title: Tanga yakapetwa
advanced.description: Painopeteka, tanga semutsetse wakavharwa unongoratidza mubvunzo nemamiriro awo.

advanced.title: Nzira yekupa mamaki
advanced.description: OER Schema: nzira yekupa mamaki yeongororo iyi (semuenzaniso mapoinzi, tsamba, chikamu muzana, kupedzisa).

advanced.title: Chinangwa chekudzidza
advanced.description: OER Schema: chinangwa chekudzidza chakabatanidzwa neongororo iyi.

developer.description: Zita rekuedzwa rinoshandiswa munzvimbo dzinoshandisa xAPI kuziva chinhu ichi
